svg.aria-label: Top-10 membership of batters across settings
svg.title: Top-10 membership of batters across settings
svg.desc: A grid with one row per player who reaches the top 10 of batters in at least one of six settings and one column per setting. Each filled cell shows the player's rank in that setting.
svg.text: Top 10 batters: rank in each setting. Blank means outside the top 10 or not eligible.
Robust core: top 10 in all four scenario columns (exclusions on or off, other = illegal ball with or without the penalty run).
Dark green: the submitted list. Light green: top 10 in that setting. Number = rank in that setting.
